sloka: प्रति आख्याय हि माम् भीरु परितापम् गमिष्यसि ।चरणेन अभिहत्य इव पुरूरवसम् ऊर्वशी ॥३-४८-१८॥
transliteration: prati ākhyāya hi mām bhīru paritāpam gamiṣyasi ।caraṇena abhihatya iva purūravasam ūrvaśī ॥3-48-18॥

translations.english: O timid lady if you reject me, you will regret like Urvasi who kicked Pururava and regretted later.
